enchantment.practical_enchantments.chine: The Chinese Can Fly~The Chinese Can Fly~Unlocks creative flight;  3x durability consumption when hit in air
enchantment.practical_enchantments.lumbe: Recursively breaks entire connected trees and leaves when chopping logs
enchantment.practical_enchantments.power: Crossbow-exclusive ranged damage boost; +25% arrow damage per level
enchantment.practical_enchantments.brigh: Grants constant Night Vision I; consumes 1 durability per second at night (13000-23000 ticks)
enchantment.practical_enchantments.destr: Blocks drop no items, only experience; base 2 XP, ores give 5 XP
enchantment.practical_enchantments.incin: Killed mobs drop no loot; experience doubled; ineffective against players
enchantment.practical_enchantments.aeria: Eliminates aerial mining speed penalty; mining speed in air equals ground speed
enchantment.practical_enchantments.behea: Killing zombies, skeletons, creepers, wither skeletons or piglins adds +2.5% head drop chance per level
enchantment.practical_enchantments.life_: Heals for 4% per level of the target's actual health lost on hit
enchantment.practical_enchantments.venom: Attacks inflict Poison: 6s at I, 12s at II; mutually exclusive with Fire Aspect and Wither
enchantment.practical_enchantments.withe: Attacks inflict Wither for 6s at I and 12s at II (works on undead); reduces weapon damage
enchantment.practical_enchantments.frenz: Gain Speed after a kill: 6s at I, 8s at II; duration doubled on axes
enchantment.practical_enchantments.demon: Cheat death at the cost of emeralds (64/56/48) plus Darkness; 60s cooldown; mutually exclusive with Undying Drop
enchantment.practical_enchantments.undyi: Cheat death, but the enchanted item is destroyed and all your items drop; fun-only enchantment, creative only
enchantment.practical_enchantments.gentl: Constant Slow Falling and fall damage immunity; disabled while sneaking; mutually exclusive with Feather Falling
enchantment.practical_enchantments.execu: Bonus multiplier on low-health targets: x1.5 (axe x2) below 35%, x3 (axe x4) below 10%
enchantment.practical_enchantments.soul_: Hits spawn XP orbs from raw damage: coefficient 0.2 per level, capped at 2 XP per level per hit
enchantment.practical_enchantments.penet: Thrown tridents deal 1.5 + 0.5 x (level-1) extra damage; with Loyalty, pulls hit targets in; mutually exclusive with Riptide
enchantment.practical_enchantments.smash: Thrown tridents instantly break hit blocks; level maps to pickaxe tier - below the tier, blocks break without drops
